summary: Round 1: the grid view replaces the play area. 41 questions, 4 root forks, longest path 38. It does NOT re-ask the geometry you already settled (chart E, §19, the label rulings, pure-math slot_center_global) — those are inherited by name at the top. QR1 is the big one: whether a grid's layout comes from a Godot container, from arithmetic, or from both as the board does today. Research changed two questions before you see them: a container CANNOT hold the cards or let them overlap, so the spring is forced into the Node2D layer either way; and the product-side coordinate seam is 8 call sites, not the ~50 the handoff estimated.
